name: Threshold Dimension of Tagged Singletons
proof: On $S=\{n+f(i),i\}$, in the order $n+f(i),i$, the restrictions of $\emptyset$, the tag singleton $\{n+f(i)\}$, and the tagged singleton $\{i,n+f(i)\}$ form the three threshold traces.  A threshold witness of dimension three would need a class member whose restriction contains all three selected coordinates, but every class member has size at most two.  Hence the threshold dimension is two.
